links.comparator_used: Model without post-processing (original vertebral localization/enumeration output) on external datasets A and B
links.effect: Identification rate increased on average by 4% (p < 0.01) on dataset A and by 4% (p = 0.01) on dataset B after the post-processing adjustment; baseline identification without post-processing was 83% (A) and 92% (B).
links.quote: After algorithm adjustment, identification rate across all vertebrae increased on average by 4 % (p < 0.01) for dataset A and also 4 % on the dataset B (p = 0.01).
